Why nobody reads the Terms of Service anymore

A new study finds that fewer than 1% of users actually read a company's Terms of Service before signing up for a new app. Researchers say the average terms of service document would take 76 working days a year to read in full.

Consumer advocates argue that companies should simplify their legal documents, while legal experts note that the current system exists largely to limit liability rather than to inform users.

Our reporters spoke with several regulators about how these documents are written, and why so few people ever open one before using a new service.
